findings.message: This change gives `reassign` to both writers, but only `create_release` gets a confirm card that shows the move (`releaseNote` and the reassign checks). `set_release_proposals` now accepts `reassign` (mcp.ts) and moves the proposal (`assignProposals`). Its card is still `releaseProposalsCard`, which shows only Release, Proposals and Kept, and the tool has no `note` hook. So in chat, a proposal is moved out of another open release without the person being told. That breaks the 'no silent move' rule in README 123/124. Fix: make `releaseProposalsCard` list each reassigned key and the release it leaves (reuse `whereItIs`/`releaseNote`), or give `set_release_proposals` the `note: releaseNote` hook. Add a variant test covering the create card, the set card, and a set card with no reassign.
findings.scenario: In chat, the model calls `set_release_proposals { projectKey: 'CON', version: 'v2.5.0', proposalKeys: ['CON-012'], reassign: ['CON-012'] }`. The card reads 'Proposals: CON-012 · Kept: proposals already released stay' and the person clicks Save. CON-012 leaves the open release v2.4.0, and the card never said so.

findings.message: `listReleaseProposals` returns `[]` for a project key that doesn't exist, the same answer as 'this project has no eligible proposals'. The model then tells the user there's nothing to release instead of saying the project is unknown. Fix: look up the project first and throw a not-found error when it's missing.
findings.scenario: `list_release_proposals { projectKey: 'CNO' }` (a typo for CON) returns [], and chat says 'No Verified or Released proposals in CNO yet'.

findings.message: The query for the project's latest release (`order by created_at desc limit 1`) now exists twice: here in `fieldsFor`, and in `pin-offers.ts` `projectFacts` (line 36). The 'already has a release' message also exists twice: `proposeRelease` and `createRelease`. The copies match today. If one changes, the pin offer's 'Create release vX' label and the card's prefilled Version (or the two refusal messages) will disagree. Fix: move each into one shared helper.

This change lets `set_release_proposals` take `reassign`, but its confirm card (`releaseProposalsCard`, write-cards.ts:42) was not updated and the tool has no `note` hook. The card lists only the proposals and says nothing about which ones will be taken out of another open release. `create_release` got `releaseNote` for this. The second writer of the same move did not. Fix: give `set_release_proposals` the same `note: releaseNote` (or add a 'Moves' line to its card), and add the tool to the AC-5 test so it checks that the move is shown before confirm.
findings.scenario: CON-012 is in open release CON v2.4.0. In chat the model calls `set_release_proposals {projectKey:'CON', version:'v8.1.0', proposalKeys:['CON-012'], reassign:['CON-012']}`. The card reads 'Proposals: CON-012', with no word that it leaves v2.4.0. The person clicks Save and CON-012 is taken out of v2.4.0 without warning. That is the silent move 123/124 set out to prevent.

findings.message: `valueOf` for a checks field keeps only values that are among the card's options. `startValues` fills `proposalKeys` from the model's input (`String(array)`), but `fieldsFor` only offers eligible proposals. A key the model passed that is not offered (not Verified/Released, withdrawn, already shipped, a mistyped or lowercase key, or one from another project) is not shown and is quietly dropped on confirm. The service never sees it, so its refusal never fires, and the release is created without that proposal. Fix: fail closed. Either keep ticked values that are not offered in the submitted value, so `propose` or the service refuses them on the field, or have `releaseCard`/`proposeRelease` check the starting `proposalKeys` and report each one that is not offered.
findings.scenario: The user says 'Create release v8.1.0 of CON with CON-014'. The model calls `create_release {projectKey:'CON', version:'v8.1.0', proposalKeys:['CON-014']}`, and CON-014 is Building. The card shows no CON-014 box. The person fills in the name, category and dates and clicks Create. `edited()` sends `proposalKeys:''`, the release is created with 0 proposals, and no refusal ever explains why CON-014 is missing.
